name: AI Discovery and digital discovery services

itemOffered.name: AI Discovery
itemOffered.description: Technical strategy and implementation to make website information easier for AI systems and search engines to discover and interpret.

itemOffered.name: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
itemOffered.description: Content and technical improvements intended to make clear, useful answers easier for answer engines to understand.

itemOffered.name: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
itemOffered.description: Semantic and content architecture practices for improving how generative search systems interpret a website.

itemOffered.name: Structured Data Implementation
itemOffered.description: Schema.org and JSON-LD implementation to describe visible website entities and their relationships.

itemOffered.name: Knowledge Graph Design
itemOffered.description: Entity and relationship modeling to provide consistent context across a website and its machine-readable resources.
